result.summary: Adds functional test coverage for the `gettxspendingprevout` RPC error condition when `mempool_only=false`, the mempool has no relevant spend, and `txospenderindex` is disabled. The test checks node behavior without the index, verifying success while spends are in the mempool and an error once spends are mined.
result.problem: An error branch in `src/rpc/mempool.cpp` for `gettxspendingprevout` was uncovered by existing functional and unit tests because `mempool_only` defaults to `true` when the spender index is unavailable.
evidence: Author references the combined coverage report showing the error throw in `src/rpc/mempool.cpp` is never reached (PR description).
result.card: Adds functional test coverage for the `gettxspendingprevout` RPC error path when invoked with `mempool_only=false` on a node lacking `txospenderindex`. Previously, that specific error branch in `src/rpc/mempool.cpp` was uncovered in automated tests because the parameter defaults to `true` without the index. Author cites functional coverage reports showing the throw was never reached. The change has no dependencies.

risk.why: Only touches functional tests; a bug could cause false test failures in CI.
